instanceVariables.name: Mend
instanceVariables.decription: Heals the nearby party member with the lowest HP. Cannot target the Cleric.

instanceVariables.name: Blinding Shot
instanceVariables.decription: The next arrow blinds the targeted tower, preventing it from attacking for a short duration.

instanceVariables.name: Rallying Guard
instanceVariables.decription: For 5 seconds, increases the Defense of all nearby party members.

instanceVariables.name: Arcane Infusion
instanceVariables.decription: Infuses the Wizard's next attack with arcane energy, massively increasing its damage.

instanceVariables.name: Purifying Light
instanceVariables.decription: Cleanses all nearby party members, removing negative status effects. Cannot target the Cleric.

instanceVariables.name: Mana Conversion
instanceVariables.decription: For 10 seconds, damage taken by the Wizard is partially converted into mana.

instanceVariables.name: Blink
instanceVariables.decription: Teleports the Ranger a short distance forward, with a 50% chance to evade incoming projectiles.

instanceVariables.name: Challenge
instanceVariables.decription: For 5 seconds, forces all towers within range to target the Warrior.

[outlineBack=#000000]A powerful crystal is being transported by a magic cart. Travel through all three dimensions and secure it from evil forces!

In every level, your objective is to escort the cart to the portal. Stay close to the cart with your characters so they can channel their magic into the crystal and keep the cart moving.

[u][color=#f20201]Attention:[/color][/u] the crystal slowly loses energy over time. Its remaining energy is shown by the [u][color=#d9bd3a]yellow bar[/color][/u] below. If it runs out completely, you lose. Keep at least one character near the cart whenever possible, and avoid leaving it unattended for too long.

Towers will attack your party! Characters have ranged attacks and unique skills for survival and attacking purposes. Skills consume Mana from a shared pool, shown by the [u][color=#247ab9]blue bar[/color][/u] below. Collecting potions will restore health and Mana.
